text.p: - The government said it will step up security measures for judges following the recent explosion of a bomb in front of a judge's house in which his wife was seriously hurt.
- Slovenia and the Chinese region of Shanghai would like to increase trade links, representatives of both sides said during a six-day visit of a Slovenian delegation to China.
- The Pension Fund said October pensions would remain unchanged.
- Britain supports Slovenia's future membership in the European Union as well as NATO, Foreign Minister Davorin Kracun said after a two-day official visit to London.
- According to unofficial data, 23 out of a total of 31 political parties in Slovenia will participate in the November 10 general election.
- Slovenia and Italy performed their first joint military exercise on the border between the two countries on Wednesday.
- Prices of ski lifts will rise by seven to 10 percent this year, ski operators said.

- Slovenian sports and cultural organisations said the government should grant them extra money to make up for the loss of tobacco sponsorship after parliament recently passed a law prohibiting advertising of tobacco products.
